subject: maths
question: A cylindrical candle, 14 cm in diameter and length 2 cm is melted to form a cuboid candle of dimensions 7 cm × 11 cm × 2 cm. How many cuboidal candles can be obtained?
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of cylindrical candle = 14 cm

Height of cylindrical candle = 2 cm

Dimensions of cuboid candle = 7 cm × 11 cm × 2 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of cuboid = l × b × h

Number of cuboidal candles = Volume of cylinder / Volume of cuboid

**Calculations:**

Radius of cylinder (r) = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm

Volume of cylinder = π × 7² × 2 = 22/7 × 49 × 2 = 308 cm³

Volume of cuboid = 7 × 11 × 2 = 154 cm³

⇒ Number of cuboidal candles = 308 ÷ 154

⇒ Number of cuboidal candles = 2

**∴ 2 cuboidal candles can be obtained.**
